invariants.rationale: Bucket index is non-negative as it represents a bucket identifier incremented from 0.
The method assigns result as the value mapped to fileIdHint in updateLocationToBucket.
A new BucketInfo was put into bucketInfoMap at the key equal to result.
The BucketInfo inserted for result uses fileIdHint as its fileId.
The BucketInfo inserted for result contains partitionPath as its partitionPath.
